title: What's New: Auditing In Purview (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Purview portal demo and event search
Data retention and advanced access methods

features.name: Auditing Business Central events in Purview
features.description: An auditing solution that allows audit administrators to see operations executed by users across all Microsoft services including Business Central in a single portal. Helps with responding to security events and forensic investigations.

features.name: Purview portal event filtering and search
features.description: Interface that allows filtering and searching for specific events across your tenant by record type, activity category, keyword search, user filter, and date range.

features.name: Environment Administration event auditing
features.description: Auditing category that includes everything you would do in the admin Center for Business Central environments.

features.name: Report Administration event auditing
features.description: Auditing category that includes any changes made to reporting in a Business Central environment.

features.name: Default Purview enablement with Microsoft 365
features.description: Auditing is included and enabled by default with most Microsoft 365 plans, requiring no additional setup to start auditing Business Central events.

features.name: Purview data retention with extension options
features.description: Purview retains audit logs for 180 days by default, but you can extend this up to 10 years by purchasing add-on licenses or with specific Microsoft 365 plans.
caveats: extended retention requires additional licenses or specific plans

features.name: PowerShell and Management Activity API access
features.description: Advanced methods to access Purview events for Business Central, allowing automation beyond the portal interface through PowerShell or the management activity API.
